physics_conclusion.dominant_error: PEC/grid geometry (staircased angled feeds, Yee orientation sampling of the device path) rather than measurement formulation

baseline_guide_normal worse than baseline_hz_line on reciprocity → axis-aligned FluxRegion is not the primary defect
